headline: Boss teleport fixed and the minimap is back; the defence designer is live on the server. Now: the designer screen and conquest raids in the game (until 16:15), then the rebuild.

features.name: Wallet login / sign-up (devnet)
features.detail: Sign-in with Solana: the wallet signs a one-time message; profile keyed by wallet; email optional. Desktop: Phantom. Android: Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter (Seed Vault).

features.name: Islands: claim, base building, RUM
features.detail: Claim mints an Island NFT; RUM store fills over time; vault keeps 60%; defences make raids harder.

features.name: Raids vs the AI captain
features.detail: Conquer another player's island: survive its designed waves and sink its guardian boss; a win loots 25% of the exposed RUM; 4 h shield. No SOL stake.

features.name: Island defence designer
features.detail: Each island is a roguelike level its owner designs: a 15-minute timeline in 1-minute windows, a points budget per window (grows each minute and with defences), enemy picks with costs, a guardian boss and its arrival minute; presets. Raiders must survive the waves and sink the guardian.

features.name: AI captain
features.detail: Named AI opponent ship on the PvP bot: 1v1 opponent and island defender.

features.name: Daily island race
features.detail: One seeded course per day; fastest time to 100 kills; daily board.

features.name: Weekly kill leaderboard + SOL rewards
features.detail: Top places paid in devnet SOL from the treasury; owner-triggered payout for the demo.

features.name: 1v1 PvP with SOL wagers
features.detail: Both deposit the stake to escrow; the winner is paid 2x; vs the AI captain the house matches the stake.

features.name: Island NFT marketplace
features.detail: List (NFT to escrow), buy with SOL, cancel; the server swaps.

features.name: Builds
features.detail: Desktop WebGL and Android APK (Solana Mobile); public build at the end.

features.name: Fixes: boss teleport, minimap
features.detail: Barnacle King teleport: crowds spawning on the boss (e.g. the miniboss pack) pushed it up to 10 m in one frame; bosses and minibosses now hold their ground (regression test). Minimap: one-time snapshot of the islands plus live icons, top right.

schedule: Defence designer on the server; boss teleport fix + minimap in the game
Designer screen and base-conquest raids in the game; deploy
Rebuild WebGL + APK, install on the Seeker, your test
Demo reset, public build if wanted, buffer

needs.text: Test the desktop build in Chrome with Phantom (devnet): http://localhost:8090/
Devnet SOL: treasury 25 SOL, test wallet 10 SOL
Solana Mobile device ready for the APK (wallet set to devnet)
Before the demo: I clear the test data (test runs on the weekly board, this week's reward record) so the demo starts clean

log: Hackathon branch hackathon-demo created; plan written.
Server core committed: wallet sign-in, Solana service (deposits, payouts, NFT mint), schema for every feature; 176 server tests pass.
Owner funded devnet: treasury 25 SOL, test wallet 10 SOL. Android will use the Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter.
Devnet proven: 0.01 SOL deposit verified, payout back, Island NFT minted (1-of-1, Metaplex metadata + master edition) and moved out of escrow. About 0.018 SOL per island mint.

Server: islands (claim + NFT mint, RUM store/vault/defences, building), raids vs the AI captain (loot, 4 h shield, optional SOL wager) and the escrow marketplace done; 197 server tests pass. Railway settings for the treasury prepared.

Server: 1v1 SOL wagers (incl. house-matched vs the AI captain), weekly SOL rewards, daily race done; all server features deployed to Railway (devnet, treasury enabled). 197 server tests pass. Live devnet end-to-end test started.

Game: MagicBlock Solana Unity SDK added; Connect Wallet on the main menu (Phantom on desktop, Mobile Wallet Adapter on Android, a test wallet in the Editor); sign-in verified against the server; EditMode 744/744. Editor test wallet funded with 0.5 SOL from the treasury.

Live devnet end-to-end test: 8 of 8 passed with two wallets (sign-in, island claims with NFT mints, a won raid with a 0.01 SOL wager paid 2x, an island sold through escrow and the NFT moved on chain, a wager refund, weekly rewards paid, daily race entries). Report: plan/hackathon/devnet-smoke.md. To clean before the demo: test runs on the weekly board and this week already marked paid.

Game: 1v1 stake picker and deposit (a real 0.01 SOL wager vs Captain Marrow settled on devnet; a refund paid on leave), Captain Marrow (banner, name over his ship, barks), the daily race (seeded voyage, kills/100 HUD, entry + board), wallets and SOL rewards on the leaderboard. EditMode 750/750.

Game: islands (world map, claim with a real Island NFT, RUM collect, buildings, shield), raids vs Captain Marrow (a 0.01 SOL stake won and paid 0.02), island market (listed to escrow, cancelled back, two islands bought) all checked on devnet. EditMode 757/757. Builds started.

Builds done: desktop WebGL (120 MB download; menu loads, Connect Wallet opens the Phantom/Solflare chooser) and Android APK (148 MB, IL2CPP ARM64, Mobile Wallet Adapter included, debug key). No phone was connected, so the APK is not installed yet.

APK installed on the Seeker (USB): wallet sign-in via Mobile Wallet Adapter worked (Captain wd8i), 1 devnet SOL sent to the phone wallet, island claim worked. The phone restarted once: a system update (boot reason reboot,ota), not the game. Owner: no stakes on raids; SOL wagers only in 1v1. Removing raid stakes, adding a full address + copy button, rebuilding WebGL and the APK.

Raids without SOL stake (game + server, deployed); wallet panel shows the full address with Copy and explorer buttons; WebGL desktop (120 MB) and APK (148.5 MB) rebuilt; the APK reinstalled on the Seeker (signed in, ~58 fps). Server 198, EditMode 758 pass.

Owner test: 1v1 wager vs Captain Marrow worked on the phone. New requests: raids conquer the base (waves + guardian boss), player-designed island defences (15 x 1-minute windows with budgets), Barnacle King teleport bug, minimap via a one-time snapshot. Server designer and the Unity fixes started.

Fixed: the Barnacle King teleport (the overlap pass let a spawning crowd shove the boss ~10 m in one frame; not the leash). Minimap back as a one-time snapshot with 10 Hz icons. Defence designer live on the server (15 windows, budgets, costs, guardian, presets). EditMode 761/761; server 206.
